name: Harald Atmanspacher
notes: Pauli-Jung dual-aspect; neutral base not 'experience-like' (Q3 s); correlations acausal, not strict laws (Q5 s).

name: Donald Davidson
notes: Q1: mental/physical are descriptions of the same events, but every event is physical; neither 'deeper reality' fits.

name: John Leslie
notes: Axiarchism (Q9 y); Spinozistic infinite minds make mind basic (Q1 n); God not personal creator in usual sense (Q8 n).

name: John Polkinghorne
notes: Dual-aspect monist; favored chaos over quantum mind (Q7 s); wanted new physics of 'active information' (Q6 y).

name: V. S. Ramachandran
notes: Q1: qualia vs neurons as two 'languages' of one thing, but he leans physicalist.

name: Bertrand Russell
notes: Q4: neutral events everywhere but not experience in particles; Q11 n since percepts are in the head.

name: Galen Strawson
notes: Q1: real physicalism says experiential IS physical, not neutral; Q6: no new physics, just inner nature.

name: Max Tegmark
notes: Math is basic; consciousness as information-processing state of matter; argued against quantum brain.

name: Pierre Teilhard de Cha
notes: Within/without of things; 'hyperphysics' (Q6 y); Q2 n though he resisted dualism.

name: Max Velmans
notes: Reflexive monism: Q11 is his signature; dual-aspect panpsychism (Q4 y).
